Discover the perfect blend of comfort, style, and convenience with our unique townhomes at Casa Linda, one of the Dominican Republic’s most trusted and established gated communities.   • 2 large bedrooms, each with its own ensuite bath

  • A half bath on the main level for guests

  • 2,971-gallon private pool

  • Covered terrace, perfect for al fresco dining or lounging

  • Functional kitchen with cooktop, oven, microwave, and drinkable water filter

  • A/C and ceiling fans in bedrooms, living room, and outdoor terrace

  • Covered carport and use of the community shuttle bus

As a homeowner in Casa Linda, you’ll have access to an impressive range of amenities including:

  • Onsite restaurants

  • A waterpark

  • Tennis and pickleball courts

  • Mini-golf

  • Walking trails

  • A Welcome Center

  • All set within a secure, 24/7 gated community.

Best of all? Enjoy all of this with low monthly maintenance fees starting at just US$195, which covers security, gardening, pool service, garbage collection, and access to all community amenities. Your tropical lifestyle is made easy.

Whether you're seeking a vacation home, a full-time residence, or an investment property, this is your chance to live the Caribbean dream—without the stress or high costs.

Only 17 townhomes are available, making this a rare opportunity to own in one of the most desirable communities on the island.

Don't miss out! Contact us todayat +1 (809) 905-5535 to schedule your visit or request more details.

Your piece of paradise is waiting!

agents.bio:
My wife and I made the decision to leave our comfortable life in Canada behind and embrace a new adventure in the Dominican Republic. We were looking for a lifestyle that offered more time outdoors, a closer connection to nature, and the freedom to raise our family in a way that aligned with our values.

Today, we're proud to call the North Coast home, where we're raising our five children and enjoying everything this beautiful country has to offer, from beach days and outdoor living to the strong sense of community and slower pace of life.

Futbol has always been a big part of my life. Having played since I was young, it was important to me that my children grew up active and involved in sports as well. While they may not have all shared my enthusiasm in the beginning, they are now all dedicated footballers who take full advantage of the opportunity to play outdoors year-round in the Caribbean sunshine.

The move wasn't always easy. We traded many of the conveniences we were accustomed to for a more hands-on Caribbean lifestyle, and that journey has given us firsthand experience with the rewards and challenges of relocating abroad. Because I've lived it myself, I understand the questions and concerns many buyers have when considering a move or investment in the Dominican Republic.

Whether you're searching for a vacation home, investment property, retirement retreat, or a permanent move to paradise, I'm committed to helping you navigate the process with honesty, local insight, and personalized service every step of the way.

agents.bio:
Mario "Crestman" Popovici stands as a distinguished Broker/Owner at the helm of The Crest Group, skillfully navigating the dynamic real estate landscapes of Punta Cana, Santo Domingo, and New York City. With an impressive 30 years of expertise, Mario specializes in residential rentals and sales within these vibrant markets. As a licensed Real Estate Broker, he plays a pivotal role in propelling the sales and marketing initiatives for The Crest Group's international branches. Moreover, Mario is committed to mentorship, guiding agents to master sales and rentals with confidence and skill. His innovation and foresight were instrumental in the establishment of The Crest Group's pioneering office in the Dominican Republic.

Mario's business acumen extends far beyond real estate. His entrepreneurial spirit led him to own and manage several successful bars and restaurants in Santiago and the North Coast of the Dominican Republic, alongside a celebrated restaurant/bar/lounge in Forest Hills, NY. Moreover, for six years, he adeptly coordinated nightlife events for Latin promotions in New York City. A true polymath, Mario is a PADI-certified diver, a Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu enthusiast, and an aficionado of skiing, paddle and golfing. This diverse managerial and business expertise provides Mario with unique insights, enabling him to deeply connect with both clients and agents alike.

Born in Bucharest, Romania, Mario embarked on a life-changing journey to New York City at a tender age, embracing the cosmopolitan lifestyles of various neighborhoods such as Queens, the Upper East Side, Hell’s Kitchen, the East Village, and Miami, before eventually settling in the Dominican Republic. Today, Mario passionately dedicates his efforts from Punta Cana, fervently helping buyers and sellers alike in realizing their dream homes and seizing lucrative investment opportunities.

Entrust your real estate aspirations to Mario Crestman's unparalleled international prowess and his cohort of dedicated, trustworthy, and transparent agents. Experience the definitive advantage that Mario brings to your property journey.

agents.bio:
Tracy Shayhorn moved to Cabarete in 2010 and never left. Fifteen-plus years later, she's not selling a postcard version of the Dominican Republic, she's selling the real one: the people, the process, the paperwork, and the pitfalls, all of it.

She manages The Crest Group's North Coast office and owns a condo, a house, and a commercial building here herself, so she's been on both sides of every deal she talks clients through. Bilingual in English and Spanish, married into the Dominican community, and backed by a trusted local network of lawyers, inspectors, and title experts, Tracy works on one rule: show the downside first. No inflated numbers, no fantasy, no "trust me." If she doesn't know something, she'll say so.

She works with international buyers, expats, investors, retirees, and remote workers relocating to the North Coast, matching people with property around Kite Beach, Encuentro, Cabarete Bay, and Sea Horse Ranch. Not everyone is her client. She's not interested in clients who want to be told what they want to hear.

boutique-oceanview-living-on-kite-beach-.name: Boutique Oceanview Living on Kite Beach - New Development
boutique-oceanview-living-on-kite-beach-.description:
Imagine this: you wake up to the sound of waves, check the wind from your balcony, and within minutes you’re launching your kite on world-famous Kite Beach. By sunset, you’re on the rooftop with a cold drink in hand, watching the sky turn pink over the ocean and mountains.

This boutique condo-hotel project has just 16 residences — all smartly designed 1-bedroom, 1.5-bath units with private terraces, sleek finishes, and included appliances. With CONFOTUR approval, you’ll pay zero property tax for 15 years and no 3% transfer tax, making this not just a lifestyle move, but a savvy investment.

Amenities check all the boxes: rooftop infinity pool & jacuzzi, BBQ and lounge/bar, co-working space for digital nomads, elevator, private parking, surf/kite lockers, and direct beach access. And with on-site management and Airbnb-friendly rules, your unit can earn income while you’re away.

WELCOME TO KITE BEACH

With more than 270 days of steady wind each year, Kite Beach is one of the world’s premier watersport destinations. Mornings often bring clean surf—perfect for SUP, longboarding, or a sunrise dip before the trades turn on. By late morning, the kites are in the sky, and the beach comes alive with color and energy.

Kite Beach is also home to world-class riders like Adeuri Corniel (Youth Olympic Gold Medalist), Alex Soto, Jose Luis Ciriaco, and Joselito Rosario—all raised right here.

Even if you’re not a kiter, the community is unmatched. This stretch of Cabarete feels smaller and more intimate than the bay, with a handful of great restaurants, a welcoming local vibe, and neighbors who become friends.

LIVE WHERE EVERYONE COMES TOGETHER

What makes this area truly special is the people. Kite Beach draws a unique mix of kiters, entrepreneurs, creatives, retirees, and travelers who come for a season and stay for a lifetime. It’s a place where coffee after your session turns into business ideas, dinner with new friends, or simply the peace of knowing you’re in the right place.

PRICING &

PAYMENT PLAN

Price Range: US$204,120 – $213,840

Size: ~72–97 m² (775–1,045 ft²)

All residences: 1-Bedroom, 1.5-Bath

ONLY 5 UNITS LEFT!

Second Floor (Units 201–204):

201 & 204 (Corner Units): ~73 m² (≈ 785 ft²) — US$206,955

202 (Interior Unit): ~72 m² (≈ 775 ft²) — US$204,120

Third Floor (Units 301–304):

302 & 303 (Interior Units): ~72 m² (≈ 775 ft²) — US$213,840

Payment Schedule:

5% to reserve

20% at Promise of Sale

50% during construction

15% at delivery

10% at title transfer

Delivery Expected: April 2026

CONFOTUR Approved: No 3% transfer tax + No property tax for 15 years

LOCATION & ACCESS

15 minutes from Puerto Plata International Airport (POP)

1.5 hours from Santiago (STI)

4 hours from Santo Domingo (SDQ)

🌊 Whether you’re here to ride, retire, invest, or simply soak in the Caribbean lifestyle, this is your front-row seat to the best of Kite Beach.

agents.bio:
Mario "Crestman" Popovici stands as a distinguished Broker/Owner at the helm of The Crest Group, skillfully navigating the dynamic real estate landscapes of Punta Cana, Santo Domingo, and New York City. With an impressive 30 years of expertise, Mario specializes in residential rentals and sales within these vibrant markets. As a licensed Real Estate Broker, he plays a pivotal role in propelling the sales and marketing initiatives for The Crest Group's international branches. Moreover, Mario is committed to mentorship, guiding agents to master sales and rentals with confidence and skill. His innovation and foresight were instrumental in the establishment of The Crest Group's pioneering office in the Dominican Republic.

Mario's business acumen extends far beyond real estate. His entrepreneurial spirit led him to own and manage several successful bars and restaurants in Santiago and the North Coast of the Dominican Republic, alongside a celebrated restaurant/bar/lounge in Forest Hills, NY. Moreover, for six years, he adeptly coordinated nightlife events for Latin promotions in New York City. A true polymath, Mario is a PADI-certified diver, a Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu enthusiast, and an aficionado of skiing, paddle and golfing. This diverse managerial and business expertise provides Mario with unique insights, enabling him to deeply connect with both clients and agents alike.

Born in Bucharest, Romania, Mario embarked on a life-changing journey to New York City at a tender age, embracing the cosmopolitan lifestyles of various neighborhoods such as Queens, the Upper East Side, Hell’s Kitchen, the East Village, and Miami, before eventually settling in the Dominican Republic. Today, Mario passionately dedicates his efforts from Punta Cana, fervently helping buyers and sellers alike in realizing their dream homes and seizing lucrative investment opportunities.

Entrust your real estate aspirations to Mario Crestman's unparalleled international prowess and his cohort of dedicated, trustworthy, and transparent agents. Experience the definitive advantage that Mario brings to your property journey.

build-your-dream-in-costa-azul-858-m2-lo.name: Build Your Dream in Costa Azul | 858 m² Lot M-11
build-your-dream-in-costa-azul-858-m2-lo.description:
In the quiet neighborhood of Costa Azul, where palm trees sway in the ocean breeze and the streets hum with the easy rhythm of Dominican life, a blank canvas awaits. This is not just land—it’s the first page of your Caribbean story.

Imagine a place where mornings begin with soft light spilling over the mountains, afternoons are filled with the scent of salt and the sound of waves just a short stroll away, and evenings bring the colors of a tropical sunset that feel like they were painted just for you. That’s Costa Azul—an authentic Cabarete community tucked between convenience and calm, close enough to town to grab dinner or meet friends, yet private enough to feel like your own sanctuary.

The property itself is a walled parcel of 858.62 m², perfectly sized to design the villa you’ve always envisioned. The solid boundary wall already provides a sense of privacy and security, giving you a head start on the building process. Whether your dream is a modern architectural masterpiece or a breezy Caribbean retreat, this land adapts to your vision.

And here’s the exciting part: right next door, a brand-new golf course is under development. This will not only elevate the neighborhood but also add tremendous value to your investment. Owning here means you’re buying into a lifestyle—morning rounds of golf, afternoons at the beach, and evenings in the vibrant heart of Cabarete.

Costa Azul has long been one of Cabarete’s best-kept secrets. Locals know it for its quiet residential feel, easy access to the beach, and growing desirability among those seeking a true balance between lifestyle and investment. Just minutes away, you’ll find world-class kitesurfing in Cabarete Bay, serene walks along Playa Encuentro, and all the dining, cafés, and nightlife that make Cabarete famous. Yet when you come home, you’re surrounded by peace.

This property isn’t just about the square meters—it’s about the life you’ll create on them. Build the villa where your family gathers for holidays, the pool where friends spend long afternoons, or the garden where you finally grow your own tropical fruit. Every corner of the land holds potential, and every day here holds possibility.

– Location: Costa Azul, San Felipe de Puerto Plata

– Lot No: M-11

– Lot Size: 858.62 m²

– Asking Price: US$125/m² – Total US$107,327.50

Costa Azul Cabarete is waiting for its next chapter. All that’s missing is your vision.

agents.bio:
Tracy Shayhorn moved to Cabarete in 2010 and never left. Fifteen-plus years later, she's not selling a postcard version of the Dominican Republic, she's selling the real one: the people, the process, the paperwork, and the pitfalls, all of it.

She manages The Crest Group's North Coast office and owns a condo, a house, and a commercial building here herself, so she's been on both sides of every deal she talks clients through. Bilingual in English and Spanish, married into the Dominican community, and backed by a trusted local network of lawyers, inspectors, and title experts, Tracy works on one rule: show the downside first. No inflated numbers, no fantasy, no "trust me." If she doesn't know something, she'll say so.

She works with international buyers, expats, investors, retirees, and remote workers relocating to the North Coast, matching people with property around Kite Beach, Encuentro, Cabarete Bay, and Sea Horse Ranch. Not everyone is her client. She's not interested in clients who want to be told what they want to hear.

agents.bio:
My wife and I made the decision to leave our comfortable life in Canada behind and embrace a new adventure in the Dominican Republic. We were looking for a lifestyle that offered more time outdoors, a closer connection to nature, and the freedom to raise our family in a way that aligned with our values.

Today, we're proud to call the North Coast home, where we're raising our five children and enjoying everything this beautiful country has to offer, from beach days and outdoor living to the strong sense of community and slower pace of life.

Futbol has always been a big part of my life. Having played since I was young, it was important to me that my children grew up active and involved in sports as well. While they may not have all shared my enthusiasm in the beginning, they are now all dedicated footballers who take full advantage of the opportunity to play outdoors year-round in the Caribbean sunshine.

The move wasn't always easy. We traded many of the conveniences we were accustomed to for a more hands-on Caribbean lifestyle, and that journey has given us firsthand experience with the rewards and challenges of relocating abroad. agents.bio:
Mario "Crestman" Popovici stands as a distinguished Broker/Owner at the helm of The Crest Group, skillfully navigating the dynamic real estate landscapes of Punta Cana, Santo Domingo, and New York City. With an impressive 30 years of expertise, Mario specializes in residential rentals and sales within these vibrant markets. As a licensed Real Estate Broker, he plays a pivotal role in propelling the sales and marketing initiatives for The Crest Group's international branches. Moreover, Mario is committed to mentorship, guiding agents to master sales and rentals with confidence and skill. His innovation and foresight were instrumental in the establishment of The Crest Group's pioneering office in the Dominican Republic.

Mario's business acumen extends far beyond real estate. His entrepreneurial spirit led him to own and manage several successful bars and restaurants in Santiago and the North Coast of the Dominican Republic, alongside a celebrated restaurant/bar/lounge in Forest Hills, NY. Moreover, for six years, he adeptly coordinated nightlife events for Latin promotions in New York City. A true polymath, Mario is a PADI-certified diver, a Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu enthusiast, and an aficionado of skiing, paddle and golfing. This diverse managerial and business expertise provides Mario with unique insights, enabling him to deeply connect with both clients and agents alike.

Born in Bucharest, Romania, Mario embarked on a life-changing journey to New York City at a tender age, embracing the cosmopolitan lifestyles of various neighborhoods such as Queens, the Upper East Side, Hell’s Kitchen, the East Village, and Miami, before eventually settling in the Dominican Republic. Today, Mario passionately dedicates his efforts from Punta Cana, fervently helping buyers and sellers alike in realizing their dream homes and seizing lucrative investment opportunities.

Entrust your real estate aspirations to Mario Crestman's unparalleled international prowess and his cohort of dedicated, trustworthy, and transparent agents. Experience the definitive advantage that Mario brings to your property journey.

Mario "Crestman" Popovici stands as a distinguished Broker/Owner at the helm of The Crest Group, skillfully navigating the dynamic real estate landscapes of Punta Cana, Santo Domingo, and New York City. His entrepreneurial spirit led him to own and manage several successful bars and restaurants in Santiago and the North Coast of the Dominican Republic, alongside a celebrated restaurant/bar/lounge in Forest Hills, NY. A true polymath, Mario is a PADI-certified diver, a Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu enthusiast, and an aficionado of skiing, paddle and golfing. agents.bio:
Tracy Shayhorn moved to Cabarete in 2010 and never left. Fifteen-plus years later, she's not selling a postcard version of the Dominican Republic, she's selling the real one: the people, the process, the paperwork, and the pitfalls, all of it.

She manages The Crest Group's North Coast office and owns a condo, a house, and a commercial building here herself, so she's been on both sides of every deal she talks clients through. Bilingual in English and Spanish, married into the Dominican community, and backed by a trusted local network of lawyers, inspectors, and title experts, Tracy works on one rule: show the downside first. No inflated numbers, no fantasy, no "trust me." If she doesn't know something, she'll say so.

She works with international buyers, expats, investors, retirees, and remote workers relocating to the North Coast, matching people with property around Kite Beach, Encuentro, Cabarete Bay, and Sea Horse Ranch. Not everyone is her client. She's not interested in clients who want to be told what they want to hear.

agents.bio:
Mario "Crestman" Popovici stands as a distinguished Broker/Owner at the helm of The Crest Group, skillfully navigating the dynamic real estate landscapes of Punta Cana, Santo Domingo, and New York City. With an impressive 30 years of expertise, Mario specializes in residential rentals and sales within these vibrant markets. As a licensed Real Estate Broker, he plays a pivotal role in propelling the sales and marketing initiatives for The Crest Group's international branches. Moreover, Mario is committed to mentorship, guiding agents to master sales and rentals with confidence and skill. His innovation and foresight were instrumental in the establishment of The Crest Group's pioneering office in the Dominican Republic.

Mario's business acumen extends far beyond real estate. His entrepreneurial spirit led him to own and manage several successful bars and restaurants in Santiago and the North Coast of the Dominican Republic, alongside a celebrated restaurant/bar/lounge in Forest Hills, NY. Moreover, for six years, he adeptly coordinated nightlife events for Latin promotions in New York City. A true polymath, Mario is a PADI-certified diver, a Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu enthusiast, and an aficionado of skiing, paddle and golfing. This diverse managerial and business expertise provides Mario with unique insights, enabling him to deeply connect with both clients and agents alike.

Born in Bucharest, Romania, Mario embarked on a life-changing journey to New York City at a tender age, embracing the cosmopolitan lifestyles of various neighborhoods such as Queens, the Upper East Side, Hell’s Kitchen, the East Village, and Miami, before eventually settling in the Dominican Republic. Today, Mario passionately dedicates his efforts from Punta Cana, fervently helping buyers and sellers alike in realizing their dream homes and seizing lucrative investment opportunities.

Entrust your real estate aspirations to Mario Crestman's unparalleled international prowess and his cohort of dedicated, trustworthy, and transparent agents. Experience the definitive advantage that Mario brings to your property journey.

agents.bio:
My wife and I made the decision to leave our comfortable life in Canada behind and embrace a new adventure in the Dominican Republic. We were looking for a lifestyle that offered more time outdoors, a closer connection to nature, and the freedom to raise our family in a way that aligned with our values.

Today, we're proud to call the North Coast home, where we're raising our five children and enjoying everything this beautiful country has to offer, from beach days and outdoor living to the strong sense of community and slower pace of life.

Futbol has always been a big part of my life. Having played since I was young, it was important to me that my children grew up active and involved in sports as well. While they may not have all shared my enthusiasm in the beginning, they are now all dedicated footballers who take full advantage of the opportunity to play outdoors year-round in the Caribbean sunshine.

The move wasn't always easy. We traded many of the conveniences we were accustomed to for a more hands-on Caribbean lifestyle, and that journey has given us firsthand experience with the rewards and challenges of relocating abroad. Because I've lived it myself, I understand the questions and concerns many buyers have when considering a move or investment in the Dominican Republic.

Whether you're searching for a vacation home, investment property, retirement retreat, or a permanent move to paradise, I'm committed to helping you navigate the process with honesty, local insight, and personalized service every step of the way.

agents.bio:
Mario "Crestman" Popovici stands as a distinguished Broker/Owner at the helm of The Crest Group, skillfully navigating the dynamic real estate landscapes of Punta Cana, Santo Domingo, and New York City. With an impressive 30 years of expertise, Mario specializes in residential rentals and sales within these vibrant markets. As a licensed Real Estate Broker, he plays a pivotal role in propelling the sales and marketing initiatives for The Crest Group's international branches. Moreover, Mario is committed to mentorship, guiding agents to master sales and rentals with confidence and skill. His innovation and foresight were instrumental in the establishment of The Crest Group's pioneering office in the Dominican Republic.

Mario's business acumen extends far beyond real estate. His entrepreneurial spirit led him to own and manage several successful bars and restaurants in Santiago and the North Coast of the Dominican Republic, alongside a celebrated restaurant/bar/lounge in Forest Hills, NY. Moreover, for six years, he adeptly coordinated nightlife events for Latin promotions in New York City. A true polymath, Mario is a PADI-certified diver, a Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu enthusiast, and an aficionado of skiing, paddle and golfing. This diverse managerial and business expertise provides Mario with unique insights, enabling him to deeply connect with both clients and agents alike.

Born in Bucharest, Romania, Mario embarked on a life-changing journey to New York City at a tender age, embracing the cosmopolitan lifestyles of various neighborhoods such as Queens, the Upper East Side, Hell’s Kitchen, the East Village, and Miami, before eventually settling in the Dominican Republic. Today, Mario passionately dedicates his efforts from Punta Cana, fervently helping buyers and sellers alike in realizing their dream homes and seizing lucrative investment opportunities.

Entrust your real estate aspirations to Mario Crestman's unparalleled international prowess and his cohort of dedicated, trustworthy, and transparent agents. Experience the definitive advantage that Mario brings to your property journey.

luxury-oceanfront-2br3ba-condos-in-cabar.name: LUXURY OCEANFRONT 1/BR CONDOS IN CABARETE
luxury-oceanfront-2br3ba-condos-in-cabar.description:
Imagine waking up to the sound of waves, stepping onto your balcony, and seeing the Caribbean stretch endlessly before you. That’s the everyday reality at Atlantic View, Cabarete’s newest oceanfront condominium project.

Here, beachfront living isn’t just a view — it’s a lifestyle. With sleek architecture, high-end finishes, and every modern comfort you could want, Atlantic View combines luxury with the laid-back charm that makes Cabarete famous worldwide. Whether you’re looking for a vacation home, a full-time residence, or an investment property with strong rental appeal, Atlantic View delivers it all.

LOCATION

- Situated in Cabarete, Puerto Plata, Dominican Republic

- Walking distance to Seawinds and downtown Cabarete

- Minutes from restaurants, bars, nightlife, and world-famous kiteboarding

PROJECT OVERVIEW

- 70 oceanfront condos across more than 15,000 m² of prime beachfront land

- All units with direct, unobstructed ocean views

- Residences from 1 to 5 bedrooms

- Sizes range from 108 m² (1,163 ft²) up to 340 m² (3,659 ft²)

PRICE RANGES BY BEDROOMS, BATHROOMS & SIZE

- 1 Bedroom | 1.5 Bathrooms | 108 m² – starting at US$ 540,000

- 2 Bedrooms + Flex | 3 Bathrooms | 152–169 m² – US$ 761,600 – US$ 846,600

- 3 Bedrooms | 3.5 Bathrooms | 166–208 m² – US$ 950,000 – US$ 1,041,750

- 3 Bedrooms + Flex | 4.5 Bathrooms | 246 m² – around US$ 1,231,850

- 4 Bedrooms + Flex | 4.5 Bathrooms | 284 m² – US$ 2,100,000

- 4 Bedrooms | 4.5 Bathrooms | 340 m² – US$ 2,549,775

Note: A Flex Room is an extra multipurpose space that can be used as a home office, guest room, media room, playroom, or storage — giving owners more versatility and value.

FEATURES & FINISHES

- Imported marble & porcelain flooring

- Precious wood doors & details

- European modular kitchens with appliances included

- European impact-resistant windows

- Central A/C (fan coil system)

- Washer/dryer included

- Tempered glass balconies

- Electronic keyless locks

AMENITIES & SERVICES

- Elegant lobby with ocean view lounge and bar

- Oceanfront pool with pool bar

- State-of-the-art gym with sea views

- Multipurpose hall for social gatherings

- Landscaped gardens and green areas

- 24/7 security & controlled access

- Full power generator

- Concierge service

- Underground utilities

- On-site management team

INVESTMENT & LIFESTYLE BENEFITS

- Professionally managed rental program (vacation & long-term)

- High rental demand in Cabarete (tourism hotspot)

- Complementary services: private chef, in-room dining, nanny, massage, laundry, tours & airport transfers

LIFESTYLE

- Atlantic View places you at the heart of Cabarete’s vibrant North Coast lifestyle:

- World-class kitesurfing, windsurfing, paddleboarding & surfing

- Golf, horseback riding, fishing & eco-tours nearby

- Over 100 excursions within 1.5 hours

- Lively dining, nightlife, and music just steps away

Contact us today to reserve your unit at Atlantic View and experience oceanfront luxury in Cabarete.

agents.bio:
Tracy Shayhorn moved to Cabarete in 2010 and never left. Fifteen-plus years later, she's not selling a postcard version of the Dominican Republic, she's selling the real one: the people, the process, the paperwork, and the pitfalls, all of it.

She manages The Crest Group's North Coast office and owns a condo, a house, and a commercial building here herself, so she's been on both sides of every deal she talks clients through. Bilingual in English and Spanish, married into the Dominican community, and backed by a trusted local network of lawyers, inspectors, and title experts, Tracy works on one rule: show the downside first. No inflated numbers, no fantasy, no "trust me." If she doesn't know something, she'll say so.

She works with international buyers, expats, investors, retirees, and remote workers relocating to the North Coast, matching people with property around Kite Beach, Encuentro, Cabarete Bay, and Sea Horse Ranch. Not everyone is her client. She's not interested in clients who want to be told what they want to hear.

agents.bio:
Mario "Crestman" Popovici stands as a distinguished Broker/Owner at the helm of The Crest Group, skillfully navigating the dynamic real estate landscapes of Punta Cana, Santo Domingo, and New York City. With an impressive 30 years of expertise, Mario specializes in residential rentals and sales within these vibrant markets. As a licensed Real Estate Broker, he plays a pivotal role in propelling the sales and marketing initiatives for The Crest Group's international branches. Moreover, Mario is committed to mentorship, guiding agents to master sales and rentals with confidence and skill. His innovation and foresight were instrumental in the establishment of The Crest Group's pioneering office in the Dominican Republic.

Mario's business acumen extends far beyond real estate. His entrepreneurial spirit led him to own and manage several successful bars and restaurants in Santiago and the North Coast of the Dominican Republic, alongside a celebrated restaurant/bar/lounge in Forest Hills, NY. Moreover, for six years, he adeptly coordinated nightlife events for Latin promotions in New York City. A true polymath, Mario is a PADI-certified diver, a Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu enthusiast, and an aficionado of skiing, paddle and golfing. This diverse managerial and business expertise provides Mario with unique insights, enabling him to deeply connect with both clients and agents alike.

Born in Bucharest, Romania, Mario embarked on a life-changing journey to New York City at a tender age, embracing the cosmopolitan lifestyles of various neighborhoods such as Queens, the Upper East Side, Hell’s Kitchen, the East Village, and Miami, before eventually settling in the Dominican Republic. Today, Mario passionately dedicates his efforts from Punta Cana, fervently helping buyers and sellers alike in realizing their dream homes and seizing lucrative investment opportunities.

Entrust your real estate aspirations to Mario Crestman's unparalleled international prowess and his cohort of dedicated, trustworthy, and transparent agents. Experience the definitive advantage that Mario brings to your property journey.

agents.bio:
Mario "Crestman" Popovici stands as a distinguished Broker/Owner at the helm of The Crest Group, skillfully navigating the dynamic real estate landscapes of Punta Cana, Santo Domingo, and New York City. With an impressive 30 years of expertise, Mario specializes in residential rentals and sales within these vibrant markets. As a licensed Real Estate Broker, he plays a pivotal role in propelling the sales and marketing initiatives for The Crest Group's international branches. Moreover, Mario is committed to mentorship, guiding agents to master sales and rentals with confidence and skill. His innovation and foresight were instrumental in the establishment of The Crest Group's pioneering office in the Dominican Republic.

Mario's business acumen extends far beyond real estate. His entrepreneurial spirit led him to own and manage several successful bars and restaurants in Santiago and the North Coast of the Dominican Republic, alongside a celebrated restaurant/bar/lounge in Forest Hills, NY. Moreover, for six years, he adeptly coordinated nightlife events for Latin promotions in New York City. A true polymath, Mario is a PADI-certified diver, a Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu enthusiast, and an aficionado of skiing, paddle and golfing. This diverse managerial and business expertise provides Mario with unique insights, enabling him to deeply connect with both clients and agents alike.

Born in Bucharest, Romania, Mario embarked on a life-changing journey to New York City at a tender age, embracing the cosmopolitan lifestyles of various neighborhoods such as Queens, the Upper East Side, Hell’s Kitchen, the East Village, and Miami, before eventually settling in the Dominican Republic. Today, Mario passionately dedicates his efforts from Punta Cana, fervently helping buyers and sellers alike in realizing their dream homes and seizing lucrative investment opportunities.

Entrust your real estate aspirations to Mario Crestman's unparalleled international prowess and his cohort of dedicated, trustworthy, and transparent agents. Experience the definitive advantage that Mario brings to your property journey.

mareal-2-the-next-wave-of-kite-beach-liv.name: MAREAL 2 – The Next Wave of Kite Beach Living - 3BR/3 BA Penthouse
mareal-2-the-next-wave-of-kite-beach-liv.description:
After the stunning success of the original project (now completely sold out!), Mareal 2 is here—bringing the same iconic design and community-forward vibe to a brand-new phase on Kite Beach. Expected delivery: February 2026.

This new development continues the signature Mareal style: soft architectural lines, vertical gardens, and natural textures like limestone and wood, all designed to echo the surrounding tropical beauty. Sleek, modern, and effortlessly relaxed—this is beachfront living with purpose.

Just like phase one, the layout is intentional: two low-rise angled buildings to maximize ocean views, natural light, and breeze flow. Residences range from stylish 1-bedrooms to expansive penthouses with rooftop terraces and private jacuzzis. Some units are set closer to the street, keeping you tapped into the heart of Kite Beach life—not hidden behind gates.

And the amenities? Next level. Think 27-meter pool, 12-person jacuzzi, on-site spa, gym, coworking café, and open-air gathering spaces. Whether you're planning to live here full-time, rent it out, or split your time—Mareal 2 is a solid lifestyle + investment move.

WELCOME TO KITE BEACH

With 270+ windy days a year, this stretch of coast is a world-class destination for kiteboarding, wing foiling, and surf. Mornings bring clean waves perfect for SUP, longboard sessions, or lazy ocean dips. By noon, the sky fills with kites and the beach comes alive.

This is home turf for Dominican kite legends like Adeuri Corniel, Alex Soto, Jose Luis Ciriaco, and Joselito Rosario—all raised right here.

And even if you’re not a rider, you’ll love the vibe. Kite Beach is more intimate and community-driven than Cabarete Bay, with a few laid-back beachfront restaurants, no chain stores, and plenty of friendly faces.

A COMMUNITY THAT FEELS LIKE FAMILY

What makes this place special isn’t just the beach—it’s the people. Kite Beach attracts a global mix of kiters, entrepreneurs, creatives, families, retirees, and travelers who come here for the lifestyle... and end up staying.

This is your chance to be part of it.

This new development continues the signature Mareal style: soft architectural lines, vertical gardens, and natural textures like limestone and wood, all designed to echo the surrounding tropical beauty. Sleek, modern, and effortlessly relaxed—this is beachfront living with purpose.

Just like phase one, the layout is intentional: two low-rise angled buildings to maximize ocean views, natural light, and breeze flow. Residences range from stylish 1-bedrooms to expansive penthouses with rooftop terraces and private jacuzzis. Some units are set closer to the street, keeping you tapped into the heart of Kite Beach life—not hidden behind gates.

And the amenities? Next level. Think 27-meter pool, 12-person jacuzzi, on-site spa, gym, coworking café, and open-air gathering spaces. Whether you're planning to live here full-time, rent it out, or split your time—Mareal 2 is a solid lifestyle + investment move.

WELCOME TO KITE BEACH

With 270+ windy days a year, this stretch of coast is a world-class destination for kiteboarding, wing foiling, and surf. Mornings bring clean waves perfect for SUP, longboard sessions, or lazy ocean dips. By noon, the sky fills with kites and the beach comes alive.

This is home turf for Dominican kite legends like Adeuri Corniel, Alex Soto, Jose Luis Ciriaco, and Joselito Rosario—all raised right here.

And even if you’re not a rider, you’ll love the vibe. Kite Beach is more intimate and community-driven than Cabarete Bay, with a few laid-back beachfront restaurants, no chain stores, and plenty of friendly faces.

What makes this place special isn’t just the beach—it’s the people. Kite Beach attracts a global mix of kiters, entrepreneurs, creatives, families, retirees, and travelers who come here for the lifestyle... and end up staying.

This is your chance to be part of it.

mirador-del-valle-land-lots-from-us70m2-.name: Mirador del Valle – Land Lots from US$70/m² | Imbert, Puerto Plata
mirador-del-valle-land-lots-from-us70m2-.description:
Mirador del Valle — Land Lots for Sale in Imbert, Puerto Plata

Mirador del Valle is a new residential land development located directly on the Carretera Imbert–Puerto Plata, offering easy highway access while backing onto a protected green/natural area (área verde) along one edge of the property.

The project is laid out in paved blocks (Manzanas A through E) plus a standalone large parcel (Lot 10-B, 1,292.70 m²), with individual lots ranging from roughly 200 m² up to 2,232 m². Lots are split into two pricing zones:

  • Área Azul (Blue Zone): US$70/m²

  • Área Gris (Gray Zone): US$85/m²

Payment Plans

To reserve a lot, put down a deposit of RD$10,000 or more. From there, you choose one of two down-payment plans:

Option A — 10% Down

  • Pay the remaining balance of your 10% down payment within 2 months of reserving

  • No interest for the first 6 months

  • After that, the balance accrues 1.5% interest per month

  • You have up to 5 years total to pay off the lot

Option B — 20% Down

  • Pay the remaining balance of your 20% down payment within 2 months of reserving

  • No interest for the first 12 months

  • After that, the balance accrues 1.5% interest per month

  • You have up to 5 years total to pay off the lot

In short: the bigger your down payment, the longer you go before interest kicks in — but both plans give you a full 5 years to finish paying.

Project timeline: infrastructure and development will be complete within 24 months.

agents.bio:
My wife and I made the decision to leave our comfortable life in Canada behind and embrace a new adventure in the Dominican Republic. We were looking for a lifestyle that offered more time outdoors, a closer connection to nature, and the freedom to raise our family in a way that aligned with our values.

Today, we're proud to call the North Coast home, where we're raising our five children and enjoying everything this beautiful country has to offer, from beach days and outdoor living to the strong sense of community and slower pace of life.

Futbol has always been a big part of my life. Having played since I was young, it was important to me that my children grew up active and involved in sports as well. While they may not have all shared my enthusiasm in the beginning, they are now all dedicated footballers who take full advantage of the opportunity to play outdoors year-round in the Caribbean sunshine.

The move wasn't always easy. We traded many of the conveniences we were accustomed to for a more hands-on Caribbean lifestyle, and that journey has given us firsthand experience with the rewards and challenges of relocating abroad. Because I've lived it myself, I understand the questions and concerns many buyers have when considering a move or investment in the Dominican Republic.

Whether you're searching for a vacation home, investment property, retirement retreat, or a permanent move to paradise, I'm committed to helping you navigate the process with honesty, local insight, and personalized service every step of the way.

agents.bio:
Mario "Crestman" Popovici stands as a distinguished Broker/Owner at the helm of The Crest Group, skillfully navigating the dynamic real estate landscapes of Punta Cana, Santo Domingo, and New York City. With an impressive 30 years of expertise, Mario specializes in residential rentals and sales within these vibrant markets. As a licensed Real Estate Broker, he plays a pivotal role in propelling the sales and marketing initiatives for The Crest Group's international branches. Moreover, Mario is committed to mentorship, guiding agents to master sales and rentals with confidence and skill. His innovation and foresight were instrumental in the establishment of The Crest Group's pioneering office in the Dominican Republic.

Mario's business acumen extends far beyond real estate. His entrepreneurial spirit led him to own and manage several successful bars and restaurants in Santiago and the North Coast of the Dominican Republic, alongside a celebrated restaurant/bar/lounge in Forest Hills, NY. Moreover, for six years, he adeptly coordinated nightlife events for Latin promotions in New York City. A true polymath, Mario is a PADI-certified diver, a Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu enthusiast, and an aficionado of skiing, paddle and golfing. This diverse managerial and business expertise provides Mario with unique insights, enabling him to deeply connect with both clients and agents alike.

Born in Bucharest, Romania, Mario embarked on a life-changing journey to New York City at a tender age, embracing the cosmopolitan lifestyles of various neighborhoods such as Queens, the Upper East Side, Hell’s Kitchen, the East Village, and Miami, before eventually settling in the Dominican Republic. Today, Mario passionately dedicates his efforts from Punta Cana, fervently helping buyers and sellers alike in realizing their dream homes and seizing lucrative investment opportunities.

Entrust your real estate aspirations to Mario Crestman's unparalleled international prowess and his cohort of dedicated, trustworthy, and transparent agents. Experience the definitive advantage that Mario brings to your property journey.

modern-new-construction-villas-in-costa-.description:
GRACE VILLAS

Costa Azul, Cabarete — Dominican Republic

Starting at USD $195,000

Live Well. Live in Grace.

Steps from Kite Beach, tucked inside the quiet, coveted enclave of Costa Azul, Grace Villas is a rare thing on the North Coast: a boutique collection of only 10 contemporary loft residences, spread across 5 architect-designed buildings. No towers. No crowds. Just ten homes, done right.

This is low-density living for people who want more than a unit — they want a place. A 500-meter walk to the sand. A front-row seat to a golf course rising next door. And an address that will only get harder to come by.

Only ten residences. Intentionally limited.

THE ADDRESS

  • Costa Azul, Cabarete — one of the North Coast's most desirable residential zones

  • Just 10 exclusive residences, ever

  • 500 meters to Kite Beach

  • 5 minutes to downtown Cabarete

  • 5 minutes to Encuentro surf break

  • 30 minutes to Puerto Plata International Airport

  • A new golf course under development next door

THE RESIDENCE

Two-level loft living, built for the way people actually want to live on the coast — open, bright, private, and effortless.

  • 2 bedrooms, 2 full bathrooms

  • Double-height living area

  • Open-concept kitchen and dining

  • Private terrace

  • Fully equipped private dip pool

  • Laundry area

  • One assigned parking space

THE DESIGN

Every townhome is split into two private loft residences — a layout that trades density for volume, privacy, and architectural presence. It's a design language built around light and air:

  • Double-height spaces that let the room breathe

  • Clean, modern lines

  • Indoor-outdoor flow that erases the line between the two

  • True cross-ventilation and natural light

  • A low-density footprint, by design

  • Engineered perimeter systems for privacy and structural stability

The result is architecture that feels current — built for a coastal lifestyle, not just placed in one.

CHOOSE YOUR COLLECTION

Grace Villas is offered across three ownership tiers, each built for a different kind of buyer — the visionary, the pragmatist, and the one who wants to walk in and stay.

🟤 BRONZE COLLECTION — USD $195,000

The canvas. A completed architectural shell, ready for your vision.

  • Completed structural envelope

  • Polished cement floors

  • Plumbing and electrical conduits installed

  • Kitchen utility connections

  • Private swimming pool, fully finished

  • Interior primer applied · exterior fully painted

⚪ SILVER COLLECTION — USD $225,000

The refined middle ground. Everything in Bronze, elevated toward move-in ready.

  • Kitchen cabinetry installed

  • Built-in closets

  • Bathrooms fully finished

  • Basic landscaping

🟡 GOLD COLLECTION — USD $250,000

Turnkey, from day one. Everything in Bronze and Silver, plus a fully curated finish.

  • Full appliance suite

  • Air conditioning throughout

  • Backup power system

  • Hot water system

  • Full lighting package, interior and exterior

  • Curtains or blinds

  • Complete landscaping

  • Full furniture package, including linens, tableware, and kitchen essentials

Move in. Rent it out. Start the same day.

THE NUMBERS

  • 5-year developer financing available

  • 50% down payment required

WHY COSTA AZUL

Costa Azul is quiet, established, and walkable — close enough to Kite Beach, Cabarete's restaurants, and its beach clubs to feel connected, private enough to still feel like a retreat. With a new golf course taking shape next door, this is a neighborhood whose value curve is still pointing up.

Grace Villas puts a limited-inventory, flexible-ownership project in exactly the right spot to capture that growth — for a home, a rental, or both.

For availability, floor plans, payment schedules, or a private site tour — contact us now.

agents.bio:
Tracy Shayhorn moved to Cabarete in 2010 and never left. Fifteen-plus years later, she's not selling a postcard version of the Dominican Republic, she's selling the real one: the people, the process, the paperwork, and the pitfalls, all of it.

She manages The Crest Group's North Coast office and owns a condo, a house, and a commercial building here herself, so she's been on both sides of every deal she talks clients through. Bilingual in English and Spanish, married into the Dominican community, and backed by a trusted local network of lawyers, inspectors, and title experts, Tracy works on one rule: show the downside first. No inflated numbers, no fantasy, no "trust me." If she doesn't know something, she'll say so.

She works with international buyers, expats, investors, retirees, and remote workers relocating to the North Coast, matching people with property around Kite Beach, Encuentro, Cabarete Bay, and Sea Horse Ranch. Not everyone is her client. She's not interested in clients who want to be told what they want to hear.

Property Highlights

• Modern Construction & Elegant Finishes

• Double-Glazed Windows
Enhanced insulation provides superior energy efficiency, reduced noise, and uninterrupted views of the surrounding landscape.

modern-villa-with-private-pool-near-kite.name: Modern Villa with Private Pool Near Kite Beach - Pre-construction
modern-villa-with-private-pool-near-kite.description:
Kite Beach Avenue is a gated villa community located on the second line of Kite Beaach in Cabarete.

Rather than a high-density condo project, this is a more residential setting made up of private two-story villas, designed with light, airflow, and outdoor living in mind.

The community offers:

– Gated entry

– 24/7 security

– Private individual lots

– Clean, modern architecture

– A structured pre-construction payment plan

It’s a more balanced approach — offering both privacy and proximity.

And yes, it also includes legally titled shared beach access, which adds an extra layer of long-term value.

AVAILABLE MODELS

All villas feature an L-shaped two-story layout that wraps around a private pool, creating a natural indoor–outdoor flow.

– Model A – 3 bedrooms / 3.5 bathrooms – Approx. 290 m² – USD $590,000

A more compact and efficient layout, ideal for buyers who want a clean, functional villa with lower entry pricing while still enjoying all the key features of the project.

– Model B – 3 bedrooms / 3.5 bathrooms – Approx. 305 m² – USD $625,000

Offers a slightly larger footprint with more generous indoor–outdoor living space, plus added architectural elements like a Brazilian oak pergola that enhance the overall feel of the home.

– Model C – 4 bedrooms / 4.5 bathrooms – Approx. 330 m² – USD $685,000

The largest option, designed for buyers who want additional bedroom capacity and more expansive living areas, making it especially well-suited for families or stronger rental potential.

General Specifications

– Approx. 380 m² lot

– 2 stories

– Private pool

– Covered terrace

– Modern neutral finishes

– Clay tile roof (color selection available)

– Aluminum sliding doors (white or black option)

– Pre-construction

Model B and C offer a slightly larger footprint along with enhanced outdoor features like Brazilian oak pergolas, which add both shade and warmth to the space.

LOCATION

The project sits on the second line of Kite Beach — close enough to walk, but far enough to feel residential.

You’re:

– A short walk to Kite Beach

– Close to restaurants and beach clubs

– A quick drive to Cabarete center

– In one of the most established areas on the North Coast

The beach access is legally titled and shared with only a limited number of neighboring properties, which helps keep it quiet and consistent over time.

DESIGN & LIFESTYLE

These homes are designed around how people actually live in Cabarete.

Open living areas.

Covered outdoor spaces.

Private pools.

A clear separation between social areas and bedrooms.

The L-shaped layout creates a sense of privacy while allowing for natural airflow throughout the home — something that makes a real difference here.

The overall feel is modern, but still comfortable and easy to live in.

RENTAL & INVESTMENT POTENTIAL

Cabarete continues to attract a steady mix of visitors:

– Families

– Digital nomads

– Long-stay winter renters

– Wind and water sports travelers

Villas with private pools and walkable beach access tend to perform well in the mid-to-upper rental range.

Buying during pre-construction also allows for a more gradual entry, with the potential to benefit as the project progresses.

This works well for buyers who are thinking about both lifestyle and long-term value.

PAYMENT STRUCTURE

– Reservation: USD $5,000

– 30% at promise of sale

– 30% during construction

– 30% at finishing stage

– 10% at delivery

Payments are spread out over the construction timeline, making it easier to plan.

WHAT TO KNOW

– Second line from the beach

– Shared, legally registered beach access

– HOA applies (amount to be confirmed)

– Furniture packages available separately

– Modern, neutral finishes included

WHO THIS PROJECT FITS BEST

– Buyers who want a quieter setting near the beach

– Families relocating to Cabarete

– Owners planning to live part-time and rent part-time

– Investors looking for a more structured, low-density project

Features

Electronics and appliances

Air conditioning

Exterior

Balcony

Beach access

General

24-hour security

Electric gate

Unfurnished

Location

Gated community

agents.bio:
Tracy Shayhorn moved to Cabarete in 2010 and never left. Fifteen-plus years later, she's not selling a postcard version of the Dominican Republic, she's selling the real one: the people, the process, the paperwork, and the pitfalls, all of it.

She manages The Crest Group's North Coast office and owns a condo, a house, and a commercial building here herself, so she's been on both sides of every deal she talks clients through. Bilingual in English and Spanish, married into the Dominican community, and backed by a trusted local network of lawyers, inspectors, and title experts, Tracy works on one rule: show the downside first. No inflated numbers, no fantasy, no "trust me." If she doesn't know something, she'll say so.

She works with international buyers, expats, investors, retirees, and remote workers relocating to the North Coast, matching people with property around Kite Beach, Encuentro, Cabarete Bay, and Sea Horse Ranch. Not everyone is her client. She's not interested in clients who want to be told what they want to hear.

move-in-ready-villa-with-private-pool-mo.name: Move-In Ready Villa with Private Pool, Mountain Views & Expansion Potential
move-in-ready-villa-with-private-pool-mo.description:
Price : US$399,000
Lot Size : 839 m²

Exceptional opportunity to acquire Villa Agua Marina 31A, a beautifully upgraded two-level villa offering modern comfort, quality finishes, and future expansion potential within one of Sosúa's most sought-after residential communities.

This inviting residence features 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, with both bedrooms located on the second level. A spacious upstairs balcony offers the possibility of being converted into a third bedroom, home office, or additional living area with minimal investment, creating added flexibility and value for future owners.

The villa enjoys peaceful mountain views and partial ocean views, creating a bright and relaxing atmosphere throughout the property. The main level features an open-concept living area, a stylish black kitchen with additional upper cabinetry for enhanced storage, a dedicated laundry area, and fully air-conditioned interior spaces, including the living room and bedrooms.

Tasteful upgrades throughout the home include quality furnishings, elegant feature walls, and carefully selected finishes that combine comfort and modern Caribbean style.

Outside, the property is surrounded by beautifully maintained landscaping and a manicured garden. Coralina-accented exterior walls add warmth and character, while the private outdoor living area is designed for both relaxation and entertaining.

Property Highlights:

  • 2 Bedrooms

  • 2 Bathrooms

  • Potential conversion to 3 bedrooms

  • Two-level villa

  • 839 m² lot

  • Mountain views

  • Partial ocean views

  • Open-concept living area

  • Modern kitchen with additional cabinetry

  • Dedicated laundry area

  • Fully air-conditioned

  • 34 m² private swimming pool

  • Premium BBQ area

  • Landscaped garden

  • Coralina exterior finishes

  • Covered parking for one vehicle

  • Additional parking available

Whether you're searching for a full-time residence, vacation home, or investment property, this villa presents an excellent opportunity to own a move-in-ready villa with quality upgrades, beautiful outdoor living spaces, and future expansion potential.

Contact us today for more information or to schedule a private viewing.

agents.bio:
My wife and I made the decision to leave our comfortable life in Canada behind and embrace a new adventure in the Dominican Republic. We were looking for a lifestyle that offered more time outdoors, a closer connection to nature, and the freedom to raise our family in a way that aligned with our values.

Today, we're proud to call the North Coast home, where we're raising our five children and enjoying everything this beautiful country has to offer, from beach days and outdoor living to the strong sense of community and slower pace of life.

Futbol has always been a big part of my life. Having played since I was young, it was important to me that my children grew up active and involved in sports as well. While they may not have all shared my enthusiasm in the beginning, they are now all dedicated footballers who take full advantage of the opportunity to play outdoors year-round in the Caribbean sunshine.

The move wasn't always easy. We traded many of the conveniences we were accustomed to for a more hands-on Caribbean lifestyle, and that journey has given us firsthand experience with the rewards and challenges of relocating abroad. Because I've lived it myself, I understand the questions and concerns many buyers have when considering a move or investment in the Dominican Republic.

Whether you're searching for a vacation home, investment property, retirement retreat, or a permanent move to paradise, I'm committed to helping you navigate the process with honesty, local insight, and personalized service every step of the way.

must-see-3-bedroom-house-with-private-bo.description:
Versatile Coastal Home Near Encuentro Surf Beach.

  • 3 Bedrooms / 2 Bathrooms in the Main House

  • Detached Studio – perfect as a rental, guest suite, or office

  • 2 Full Kitchens – ideal for extended families or dual living

  • 2 Separate Living Rooms – space and privacy for everyone

  • 1 Bedroom on the Main Floor, 2 Bedrooms Upstairs

Prime Location – just minutes from Encuentro Surf Beach

Advantages & Key Amenities of Living in Playa Encuentro:

  • Prime Coastal Location – Nestled between Cabarete and Sosúa on the north coast of the Dominican Republic, Playa Encuentro offers the perfect blend of seaside living and natural beauty.

  • Beach Lifestyle – Ideal for those who love the ocean, water sports, and a relaxed coastal atmosphere away from crowded tourist areas.

  • Surf Paradise – World-famous for its consistent waves and coral reef breaks, Playa Encuentro attracts surfers of all levels year-round.

  • Steps from the Ocean – Enjoy daily ocean views, fresh sea breezes, and breathtaking sunrises — all just minutes from your doorstep.

  • Tranquil & Welcoming Community – A balanced mix of local residents, surfers, and international expats creates a friendly, laid-back environment.

  • Nature + Comfort – Surrounded by tropical greenery, yet close to essential services, restaurants, and Cabarete’s vibrant beach scene.

  • Relaxed Coastal Living – Experience the best of both worlds: serenity by the sea and easy access to everything you need.

This rare property offers unmatched versatility in a highly sought-after coastal area. Whether you’re looking for a family home, investment opportunity, or vacation getaway, this home has it all.

Don’t wait—schedule your private showing today and discover its full potential!

Today, we're proud to call the North Coast home, where we're raising our five children and enjoying everything this beautiful country has to offer. From beach days and outdoor living to the strong sense of community and slower pace of life.

The move wasn't always easy. We traded many of the conveniences we were accustomed to for a more hands-on Caribbean lifestyle, and that journey has given us firsthand experience with the rewards and challenges of relocating abroad. Because I've lived it myself, I understand the questions and concerns many buyers have when considering a move or investment in the Dominican Republic.

Whether you're searching for a vacation home, investment property, retirement retreat, or a permanent move to paradise, I'm committed to helping you navigate the process with honesty, local insight, and personalized service every step of the way.

Experience elevated beachfront living in this exceptional 225 sqm (2,500 sq ft) oceanfront residence at Cristal Oasis, where breathtaking views of the Atlantic Ocean and resort-style pool create the perfect Caribbean retreat.

Featuring 3 spacious bedrooms, 3 full bathrooms, and an additional half bath, this beautifully designed home offers the perfect blend of luxury, comfort, and functionality in one of Cabarete's most prestigious beachfront communities.

The open-concept layout seamlessly connects the bright living and dining areas to a modern kitchen equipped with upgraded black appliances and ample cabinetry—ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. One of the property's most exclusive features is its private in-unit elevator, secured with a locking security door, offering unmatched privacy and effortless access. Designed for year-round comfort, the residence also includes two central air-conditioning units, ceiling fans throughout, and solar panels that improve energy efficiency and help reduce operating costs.

Residents enjoy first-class amenities, including two underground parking spaces, a private storage room, 24-hour security, and a full-building backup generator that ensures uninterrupted comfort. Outside, a spectacular 70-foot beachfront saltwater swimming pool offers the ultimate resort-style lifestyle just steps from the ocean.

Perfectly located in the heart of Cabarete, you'll enjoy direct beach access and be just a short walk from world-class restaurants, cafés, shopping, and vibrant nightlife—offering the ideal combination of luxury, convenience, and Caribbean charm.

Whether you're searching for your dream beachfront residence, a luxurious vacation getaway, or a high-performing investment property, this is an opportunity you won't want to miss. Contact us today to schedule your private tour and discover everything this extraordinary oceanfront home has to offer.

agents.bio:
Mario "Crestman" Popovici stands as a distinguished Broker/Owner at the helm of The Crest Group, skillfully navigating the dynamic real estate landscapes of Punta Cana, Santo Domingo, and New York City. With an impressive 30 years of expertise, Mario specializes in residential rentals and sales within these vibrant markets. As a licensed Real Estate Broker, he plays a pivotal role in propelling the sales and marketing initiatives for The Crest Group's international branches. Moreover, Mario is committed to mentorship, guiding agents to master sales and rentals with confidence and skill. His innovation and foresight were instrumental in the establishment of The Crest Group's pioneering office in the Dominican Republic.

Mario's business acumen extends far beyond real estate. His entrepreneurial spirit led him to own and manage several successful bars and restaurants in Santiago and the North Coast of the Dominican Republic, alongside a celebrated restaurant/bar/lounge in Forest Hills, NY. Moreover, for six years, he adeptly coordinated nightlife events for Latin promotions in New York City. A true polymath, Mario is a PADI-certified diver, a Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu enthusiast, and an aficionado of skiing, paddle and golfing. This diverse managerial and business expertise provides Mario with unique insights, enabling him to deeply connect with both clients and agents alike.

Born in Bucharest, Romania, Mario embarked on a life-changing journey to New York City at a tender age, embracing the cosmopolitan lifestyles of various neighborhoods such as Queens, the Upper East Side, Hell’s Kitchen, the East Village, and Miami, before eventually settling in the Dominican Republic. Today, Mario passionately dedicates his efforts from Punta Cana, fervently helping buyers and sellers alike in realizing their dream homes and seizing lucrative investment opportunities.

Entrust your real estate aspirations to Mario Crestman's unparalleled international prowess and his cohort of dedicated, trustworthy, and transparent agents. Experience the definitive advantage that Mario brings to your property journey.

agents.bio:
My wife and I made the decision to leave our comfortable life in Canada behind and embrace a new adventure in the Dominican Republic. We were looking for a lifestyle that offered more time outdoors, a closer connection to nature, and the freedom to raise our family in a way that aligned with our values.

Today, we're proud to call the North Coast home, where we're raising our five children and enjoying everything this beautiful country has to offer, from beach days and outdoor living to the strong sense of community and slower pace of life.

Futbol has always been a big part of my life. Having played since I was young, it was important to me that my children grew up active and involved in sports as well. While they may not have all shared my enthusiasm in the beginning, they are now all dedicated footballers who take full advantage of the opportunity to play outdoors year-round in the Caribbean sunshine.

The move wasn't always easy. We traded many of the conveniences we were accustomed to for a more hands-on Caribbean lifestyle, and that journey has given us firsthand experience with the rewards and challenges of relocating abroad. Because I've lived it myself, I understand the questions and concerns many buyers have when considering a move or investment in the Dominican Republic.

Whether you're searching for a vacation home, investment property, retirement retreat, or a permanent move to paradise, I'm committed to helping you navigate the process with honesty, local insight, and personalized service every step of the way.

agents.bio:
Tracy Shayhorn moved to Cabarete in 2010 and never left. Fifteen-plus years later, she's not selling a postcard version of the Dominican Republic, she's selling the real one: the people, the process, the paperwork, and the pitfalls, all of it.

She manages The Crest Group's North Coast office and owns a condo, a house, and a commercial building here herself, so she's been on both sides of every deal she talks clients through. Bilingual in English and Spanish, married into the Dominican community, and backed by a trusted local network of lawyers, inspectors, and title experts, Tracy works on one rule: show the downside first. No inflated numbers, no fantasy, no "trust me." If she doesn't know something, she'll say so.

She works with international buyers, expats, investors, retirees, and remote workers relocating to the North Coast, matching people with property around Kite Beach, Encuentro, Cabarete Bay, and Sea Horse Ranch. Not everyone is her client. She's not interested in clients who want to be told what they want to hear.

agents.bio:
Mario "Crestman" Popovici stands as a distinguished Broker/Owner at the helm of The Crest Group, skillfully navigating the dynamic real estate landscapes of Punta Cana, Santo Domingo, and New York City. With an impressive 30 years of expertise, Mario specializes in residential rentals and sales within these vibrant markets. As a licensed Real Estate Broker, he plays a pivotal role in propelling the sales and marketing initiatives for The Crest Group's international branches. Moreover, Mario is committed to mentorship, guiding agents to master sales and rentals with confidence and skill. His innovation and foresight were instrumental in the establishment of The Crest Group's pioneering office in the Dominican Republic.

Mario's business acumen extends far beyond real estate. His entrepreneurial spirit led him to own and manage several successful bars and restaurants in Santiago and the North Coast of the Dominican Republic, alongside a celebrated restaurant/bar/lounge in Forest Hills, NY. Moreover, for six years, he adeptly coordinated nightlife events for Latin promotions in New York City. A true polymath, Mario is a PADI-certified diver, a Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu enthusiast, and an aficionado of skiing, paddle and golfing. This diverse managerial and business expertise provides Mario with unique insights, enabling him to deeply connect with both clients and agents alike.

Born in Bucharest, Romania, Mario embarked on a life-changing journey to New York City at a tender age, embracing the cosmopolitan lifestyles of various neighborhoods such as Queens, the Upper East Side, Hell’s Kitchen, the East Village, and Miami, before eventually settling in the Dominican Republic. Today, Mario passionately dedicates his efforts from Punta Cana, fervently helping buyers and sellers alike in realizing their dream homes and seizing lucrative investment opportunities.

Entrust your real estate aspirations to Mario Crestman's unparalleled international prowess and his cohort of dedicated, trustworthy, and transparent agents. Experience the definitive advantage that Mario brings to your property journey.

agents.bio:
Tracy Shayhorn moved to Cabarete in 2010 and never left. Fifteen-plus years later, she's not selling a postcard version of the Dominican Republic, she's selling the real one: the people, the process, the paperwork, and the pitfalls, all of it.

She manages The Crest Group's North Coast office and owns a condo, a house, and a commercial building here herself, so she's been on both sides of every deal she talks clients through. Bilingual in English and Spanish, married into the Dominican community, and backed by a trusted local network of lawyers, inspectors, and title experts, Tracy works on one rule: show the downside first. No inflated numbers, no fantasy, no "trust me." If she doesn't know something, she'll say so.

She works with international buyers, expats, investors, retirees, and remote workers relocating to the North Coast, matching people with property around Kite Beach, Encuentro, Cabarete Bay, and Sea Horse Ranch. Not everyone is her client. She's not interested in clients who want to be told what they want to hear.

agents.bio:
Mario "Crestman" Popovici stands as a distinguished Broker/Owner at the helm of The Crest Group, skillfully navigating the dynamic real estate landscapes of Punta Cana, Santo Domingo, and New York City. With an impressive 30 years of expertise, Mario specializes in residential rentals and sales within these vibrant markets. As a licensed Real Estate Broker, he plays a pivotal role in propelling the sales and marketing initiatives for The Crest Group's international branches. Moreover, Mario is committed to mentorship, guiding agents to master sales and rentals with confidence and skill. His innovation and foresight were instrumental in the establishment of The Crest Group's pioneering office in the Dominican Republic.

Mario's business acumen extends far beyond real estate. His entrepreneurial spirit led him to own and manage several successful bars and restaurants in Santiago and the North Coast of the Dominican Republic, alongside a celebrated restaurant/bar/lounge in Forest Hills, NY. Moreover, for six years, he adeptly coordinated nightlife events for Latin promotions in New York City. A true polymath, Mario is a PADI-certified diver, a Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu enthusiast, and an aficionado of skiing, paddle and golfing. This diverse managerial and business expertise provides Mario with unique insights, enabling him to deeply connect with both clients and agents alike.

Born in Bucharest, Romania, Mario embarked on a life-changing journey to New York City at a tender age, embracing the cosmopolitan lifestyles of various neighborhoods such as Queens, the Upper East Side, Hell’s Kitchen, the East Village, and Miami, before eventually settling in the Dominican Republic. Today, Mario passionately dedicates his efforts from Punta Cana, fervently helping buyers and sellers alike in realizing their dream homes and seizing lucrative investment opportunities.

Entrust your real estate aspirations to Mario Crestman's unparalleled international prowess and his cohort of dedicated, trustworthy, and transparent agents. Experience the definitive advantage that Mario brings to your property journey.

steps-from-the-sand-steps-from-a-tax-bre.name: Steps From the Sand, Steps From a Tax Break That Disappears at Closing
steps-from-the-sand-steps-from-a-tax-bre.description:
CRISTAL OASIS

Cabarete Beach — Dominican Republic

Offered at USD $1,000,000


Ground Floor. Ocean Front. Yours.

Directly on the sand in the center of Cabarete, Cristal Oasis is a brand-new beachfront condominium where the ocean isn't a view from a balcony — it's outside your sliding glass doors. This ground-floor, 2,152-square-foot residence opens straight onto the pool deck. No stairs, no compromise, just steps to the water.

A tax advantage that closes the moment title transfers. Buy before that happens, and it transfers with you.


The Address

  • Cristal Oasis Condominium, center of Cabarete Beach

  • Ground floor, direct access to the pool deck

  • Directly on the ocean

  • Steps from Cabarete's restaurants, beach clubs, and kite culture

The Residence

Turnkey, ground-floor living built for the way people actually use a beach home.

  • 2,152 sqft (~200sqm)

  • 2 bedrooms, plus a flexible 3rd bedroom currently opened into an entertainment lounge (pool table, dartboard, pull-out sofa bed) — reconvertible to a 3rd bedroom

  • 3 full bathrooms

  • 2 assigned parking spaces

  • Large, locked private storage room in the underground garage

  • Fully furnished, brand new condition

The Building

  • Large pool and jacuzzi

  • 24/7 security

  • Fitness center in the underground parking level

  • Solar power — electric bills run remarkably low

  • Built by George Coutu, a name well known across the North Coast, and his daughter Ele — both keeping condos in the building for themselves (George in the penthouse, Ele as her home), and both sitting on the HOA

The Tax Advantage

Cristal Oasis carries a Confotur exemption with 12 years of property tax relief remaining. It only transfers to a new owner through a pre-title sale — once the current owner receives title, the exemption locks to them alone. Buy now, and the next owner inherits a benefit that otherwise disappears for good.


The Numbers

  • HOA: ~$350/month

  • Rentals permitted; comparable units in the building rent for $5,000–$8,000/month

Why Cabarete

Cabarete is the North Coast's best-known beach town — established restaurants, beach clubs, a global kitesurfing scene, and steady rental demand from a mix of long-stay expats and short-term visitors. Cristal Oasis puts a brand-new, ground-floor oceanfront residence at the center of it.

Today, Mario passionately dedicates his efforts from Punta Cana, fervently helping buyers and sellers alike in realizing their dream homes and seizing lucrative investment opportunities.

thoughtfully-designed-4-br-villa-steps-f.description:
Kite Beach Avenue is a gated villa community located on the second line of Kite Beaach in Cabarete.

Rather than a high-density condo project, this is a more residential setting made up of private two-story villas, designed with light, airflow, and outdoor living in mind.

The community offers:

– Gated entry

– 24/7 security

– Private individual lots

– Clean, modern architecture

– A structured pre-construction payment plan

It’s a more balanced approach — offering both privacy and proximity.

And yes, it also includes legally titled shared beach access, which adds an extra layer of long-term value.

AVAILABLE MODELS

All villas feature an L-shaped two-story layout that wraps around a private pool, creating a natural indoor–outdoor flow.

– Model A – 3 bedrooms / 3.5 bathrooms – Approx. 290 m² – USD $590,000

A more compact and efficient layout, ideal for buyers who want a clean, functional villa with lower entry pricing while still enjoying all the key features of the project.

– Model B – 3 bedrooms / 3.5 bathrooms – Approx. 305 m² – USD $625,000

Offers a slightly larger footprint with more generous indoor–outdoor living space, plus added architectural elements like a Brazilian oak pergola that enhance the overall feel of the home.

– Model C – 4 bedrooms / 4.5 bathrooms – Approx. 330 m² – USD $685,000

The largest option, designed for buyers who want additional bedroom capacity and more expansive living areas, making it especially well-suited for families or stronger rental potential.

General Specifications

– Approx. 380 m² lot

– 2 stories

– Private pool

– Covered terrace

– Modern neutral finishes

– Clay tile roof (color selection available)

– Aluminum sliding doors (white or black option)

– Pre-construction

Model B and C offer a slightly larger footprint along with enhanced outdoor features like Brazilian oak pergolas, which add both shade and warmth to the space.

LOCATION

The project sits on the second line of Kite Beach — close enough to walk, but far enough to feel residential.

You’re:

– A short walk to Kite Beach

– Close to restaurants and beach clubs

– A quick drive to Cabarete center

– In one of the most established areas on the North Coast

The beach access is legally titled and shared with only a limited number of neighboring properties, which helps keep it quiet and consistent over time.

DESIGN & LIFESTYLE

These homes are designed around how people actually live in Cabarete.

Open living areas.

Covered outdoor spaces.

Private pools.

A clear separation between social areas and bedrooms.

The L-shaped layout creates a sense of privacy while allowing for natural airflow throughout the home — something that makes a real difference here.

The overall feel is modern, but still comfortable and easy to live in.

RENTAL & INVESTMENT POTENTIAL

Cabarete continues to attract a steady mix of visitors:

– Families

– Digital nomads

– Long-stay winter renters

– Wind and water sports travelers

Villas with private pools and walkable beach access tend to perform well in the mid-to-upper rental range.

Buying during pre-construction also allows for a more gradual entry, with the potential to benefit as the project progresses.

This works well for buyers who are thinking about both lifestyle and long-term value.

– Reservation: USD $5,000

– 30% at promise of sale

– 30% during construction

– 30% at finishing stage

– 10% at delivery

Payments are spread out over the construction timeline, making it easier to plan.

– Furniture packages available separately

– Modern, neutral finishes included
