agents.bio:
My wife and I made the decision to leave our comfortable life in Canada behind and embrace a new adventure in the Dominican Republic. We were looking for a lifestyle that offered more time outdoors, a closer connection to nature, and the freedom to raise our family in a way that aligned with our values.

Today, we're proud to call the North Coast home, where we're raising our five children and enjoying everything this beautiful country has to offer, from beach days and outdoor living to the strong sense of community and slower pace of life.

Futbol has always been a big part of my life. Having played since I was young, it was important to me that my children grew up active and involved in sports as well. While they may not have all shared my enthusiasm in the beginning, they are now all dedicated footballers who take full advantage of the opportunity to play outdoors year-round in the Caribbean sunshine.

The move wasn't always easy. We traded many of the conveniences we were accustomed to for a more hands-on Caribbean lifestyle, and that journey has given us firsthand experience with the rewards and challenges of relocating abroad. Because I've lived it myself, I understand the questions and concerns many buyers have when considering a move or investment in the Dominican Republic.

Whether you're searching for a vacation home, investment property, retirement retreat, or a permanent move to paradise, I'm committed to helping you navigate the process with honesty, local insight, and personalized service every step of the way.

turnkey-beachfront-hotel-on-kite-beach-c.name: Turnkey Beachfront Hotel on Kite Beach, Cabarete
turnkey-beachfront-hotel-on-kite-beach-c.description:
Step into one of the most exciting investment opportunities on the Dominican Republic’s North Coast: a 26-room boutique hotel perfectly positioned on the sands of Cabarete’s world-famous Kite Beach.

Along with its diverse guest accommodations, the property also features a two-bedroom owner’s unit with direct beach views and a rooftop terrace—perfect for private use or as an additional high-value rental option.

Spread across a 1,022 m² beachfront lot with 836 m² of built space, this property blends prime location, established operations, and multiple revenue streams—all in the heart of Cabarete’s thriving water-sports and tourism scene.

GUEST ACCOMMODATIONS

-26 units in total, including:

-2 Basic Rooms

-1 Standard Room (no A/C)

-8 Standard Rooms (with A/C)

-2 Partial Ocean View Rooms

-4 Ground Floor Units

-6 Side Ocean View Units

-1 Small Penthouse

-1 Large Penthouse

-1 One-Bedroom Apartment (with full kitchen)

Twelve of the units are equipped with kitchenettes, and the one-bedroom apartment includes a full kitchen—ideal for longer stays and family rentals.

ON-SITE AMENITIES

-Direct beachfront restaurant/bar with covered deck—prime location for dining with an ocean view

-Dedicated commercial space suitable for a kite school (or other tourism business)

-Swimming pool with sun deck

-Reception office

-Additional kitchen & utility/laundry rooms

-Common-area restroom near the pool & outdoor shower

-Diesel generator for reliable power

-Kite school/storage room

RENTAL AND BUSINESS POTENTIAL

What makes this property unique is its flexibility:

- Lease out the restaurant/bar and the kite school space separately for steady, passive income.

- OR run it as a fully integrated hospitality business—hotel, restaurant, and kite school combined—creating a one-stop destination for Cabarete’s tourism market.

STRONG MARKET POSITION

- Established relationships with kiteboarding & surf schools (including nearby Encuentro Beach)

- Regularly hosts large group bookings from nonprofit organizations

- Active listings across Booking.com, Agoda, Kayak, Priceline, Expedia, Airbnb, and TripAdvisor, plus strong presence on Facebook and Instagram

- Well-maintained property: original 10 rooms built in the 1990s, owner’s unit added in 2010, and 16 additional units built in 2012

- Major electrical & plumbing updates within the last 4 years

- Staffed with full-time reception/maintenance and part-time housekeeping support

WHY THIS HOTEL?

- This is more than just a hotel—it’s a beachfront business ecosystem in one of the Caribbean’s most vibrant tourism destinations. With Cabarete continuing to grow as the kiteboarding capital of the Caribbean, opportunities like this rarely hit the market.

- Whether you’re an investor seeking a turnkey hospitality operation or an entrepreneur wanting to run a restaurant + kite school + hotel under one roof, this property offers unmatched potential and lifestyle appeal.

WHY KITE BEACH?

- Kite Beach isn’t just a location—it’s a global brand. Known as the kiteboarding capital of the Caribbean, this lively stretch of coastline attracts water-sports enthusiasts, digital nomads, families, and travelers from all over the world.

- Here, the horizon fills daily with colorful kites while the beach buzzes with surf schools, cafés, and an international community that thrives on adventure. Beyond kiteboarding, guests enjoy:

- Consistent year-round trade winds for reliable conditions

- Nearby Playa Encuentro, the Dominican Republic’s premier surf break

- A vibrant mix of restaurants, bars, and nightlife just minutes away in Cabarete town

- A welcoming expat and local community that blends cultures and lifestyles

- For investors, owning a hotel here means securing a front-row seat in one of the Caribbean’s most in-demand tourism hubs, where sports, lifestyle, and steady rental demand intersect.

A rare chance to own and operate a true beachfront landmark on Kite Beach, Cabarete.

Private pool with standard chlorination (salt system optional after 6 weeks), Coraline pool deck & coping, and covered terrace with ceiling fan.

Climate control: 10,000 BTU A/C in every bedroom; additional ceiling fan in the living room.

Bright interiors: Uniform ceramic tile flooring throughout; premium acrylic interior paint; textured, elastic exterior paint to resist cracking.

Windows & doors: Aluminum sliding doors/windows with removable insect screens; privacy glass in bathrooms; metal exterior utility doors for longevity.

Kitchen: Granite countertops (standard), soft-close cabinetry (MDF/melamine fronts), under-mount double stainless sink, fridge/stove ready; island overhang where applicable.

Exterior & parking: Paved entry/walkway; 1 car + golf-cart parking (2+ car spaces recommended for 3-bed models); galvanized painted rails where needed.

Storage & closets: Standard interior door heights (210 cm); bedroom locks; defined walk-in closet and wardrobe dimensions.

Warranties: 5-year structural coverage; 1-year roof; manufacturer warranties on fixtures. Landscaping guaranteed with proper care.

Bilingual in English and Spanish, married into the Dominican community, and backed by a trusted local network of lawyers, inspectors, and title experts, Tracy works on one rule: show the downside first. agents.bio:
My wife and I made the decision to leave our comfortable life in Canada behind and embrace a new adventure in the Dominican Republic. We were looking for a lifestyle that offered more time outdoors, a closer connection to nature, and the freedom to raise our family in a way that aligned with our values.

Today, we're proud to call the North Coast home, where we're raising our five children and enjoying everything this beautiful country has to offer, from beach days and outdoor living to the strong sense of community and slower pace of life.

Futbol has always been a big part of my life. Having played since I was young, it was important to me that my children grew up active and involved in sports as well. While they may not have all shared my enthusiasm in the beginning, they are now all dedicated footballers who take full advantage of the opportunity to play outdoors year-round in the Caribbean sunshine.

The move wasn't always easy. We traded many of the conveniences we were accustomed to for a more hands-on Caribbean lifestyle, and that journey has given us firsthand experience with the rewards and challenges of relocating abroad. Because I've lived it myself, I understand the questions and concerns many buyers have when considering a move or investment in the Dominican Republic.

Whether you're searching for a vacation home, investment property, retirement retreat, or a permanent move to paradise, I'm committed to helping you navigate the process with honesty, local insight, and personalized service every step of the way.

agents.bio:
My wife and I made the decision to leave our comfortable life in Canada behind and embrace a new adventure in the Dominican Republic. We were looking for a lifestyle that offered more time outdoors, a closer connection to nature, and the freedom to raise our family in a way that aligned with our values.

Today, we're proud to call the North Coast home, where we're raising our five children and enjoying everything this beautiful country has to offer, from beach days and outdoor living to the strong sense of community and slower pace of life.

Futbol has always been a big part of my life. Having played since I was young, it was important to me that my children grew up active and involved in sports as well. While they may not have all shared my enthusiasm in the beginning, they are now all dedicated footballers who take full advantage of the opportunity to play outdoors year-round in the Caribbean sunshine.

The move wasn't always easy. We traded many of the conveniences we were accustomed to for a more hands-on Caribbean lifestyle, and that journey has given us firsthand experience with the rewards and challenges of relocating abroad. Because I've lived it myself, I understand the questions and concerns many buyers have when considering a move or investment in the Dominican Republic.

Whether you're searching for a vacation home, investment property, retirement retreat, or a permanent move to paradise, I'm committed to helping you navigate the process with honesty, local insight, and personalized service every step of the way.

agents.bio:
Mario "Crestman" Popovici stands as a distinguished Broker/Owner at the helm of The Crest Group, skillfully navigating the dynamic real estate landscapes of Punta Cana, Santo Domingo, and New York City. With an impressive 30 years of expertise, Mario specializes in residential rentals and sales within these vibrant markets. As a licensed Real Estate Broker, he plays a pivotal role in propelling the sales and marketing initiatives for The Crest Group's international branches. Moreover, Mario is committed to mentorship, guiding agents to master sales and rentals with confidence and skill. His innovation and foresight were instrumental in the establishment of The Crest Group's pioneering office in the Dominican Republic.

Mario's business acumen extends far beyond real estate. His entrepreneurial spirit led him to own and manage several successful bars and restaurants in Santiago and the North Coast of the Dominican Republic, alongside a celebrated restaurant/bar/lounge in Forest Hills, NY. Moreover, for six years, he adeptly coordinated nightlife events for Latin promotions in New York City. A true polymath, Mario is a PADI-certified diver, a Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu enthusiast, and an aficionado of skiing, paddle and golfing. This diverse managerial and business expertise provides Mario with unique insights, enabling him to deeply connect with both clients and agents alike.

Born in Bucharest, Romania, Mario embarked on a life-changing journey to New York City at a tender age, embracing the cosmopolitan lifestyles of various neighborhoods such as Queens, the Upper East Side, Hell’s Kitchen, the East Village, and Miami, before eventually settling in the Dominican Republic. Today, Mario passionately dedicates his efforts from Punta Cana, fervently helping buyers and sellers alike in realizing their dream homes and seizing lucrative investment opportunities.

Entrust your real estate aspirations to Mario Crestman's unparalleled international prowess and his cohort of dedicated, trustworthy, and transparent agents. Experience the definitive advantage that Mario brings to your property journey.

agents.bio:
Mario "Crestman" Popovici stands as a distinguished Broker/Owner at the helm of The Crest Group, skillfully navigating the dynamic real estate landscapes of Punta Cana, Santo Domingo, and New York City. With an impressive 30 years of expertise, Mario specializes in residential rentals and sales within these vibrant markets. As a licensed Real Estate Broker, he plays a pivotal role in propelling the sales and marketing initiatives for The Crest Group's international branches. Moreover, Mario is committed to mentorship, guiding agents to master sales and rentals with confidence and skill. His innovation and foresight were instrumental in the establishment of The Crest Group's pioneering office in the Dominican Republic.

Mario's business acumen extends far beyond real estate. His entrepreneurial spirit led him to own and manage several successful bars and restaurants in Santiago and the North Coast of the Dominican Republic, alongside a celebrated restaurant/bar/lounge in Forest Hills, NY. Moreover, for six years, he adeptly coordinated nightlife events for Latin promotions in New York City. A true polymath, Mario is a PADI-certified diver, a Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu enthusiast, and an aficionado of skiing, paddle and golfing. This diverse managerial and business expertise provides Mario with unique insights, enabling him to deeply connect with both clients and agents alike.

Born in Bucharest, Romania, Mario embarked on a life-changing journey to New York City at a tender age, embracing the cosmopolitan lifestyles of various neighborhoods such as Queens, the Upper East Side, Hell’s Kitchen, the East Village, and Miami, before eventually settling in the Dominican Republic. Today, Mario passionately dedicates his efforts from Punta Cana, fervently helping buyers and sellers alike in realizing their dream homes and seizing lucrative investment opportunities.

Entrust your real estate aspirations to Mario Crestman's unparalleled international prowess and his cohort of dedicated, trustworthy, and transparent agents. Experience the definitive advantage that Mario brings to your property journey.

agents.bio:
Tracy Shayhorn moved to Cabarete in 2010 and never left. Fifteen-plus years later, she's not selling a postcard version of the Dominican Republic, she's selling the real one: the people, the process, the paperwork, and the pitfalls, all of it.

She manages The Crest Group's North Coast office and owns a condo, a house, and a commercial building here herself, so she's been on both sides of every deal she talks clients through. Bilingual in English and Spanish, married into the Dominican community, and backed by a trusted local network of lawyers, inspectors, and title experts, Tracy works on one rule: show the downside first. No inflated numbers, no fantasy, no "trust me." If she doesn't know something, she'll say so.

She works with international buyers, expats, investors, retirees, and remote workers relocating to the North Coast, matching people with property around Kite Beach, Encuentro, Cabarete Bay, and Sea Horse Ranch. Not everyone is her client. She's not interested in clients who want to be told what they want to hear.
